cases.prompt: Use $principle-subtract-before-you-add to propose a local implementation sequence for adding a label filter to a saved-search service. Evidence: GET /search currently calls validate_labels(request.labels), then SearchQuery(labels=request.labels) whose constructor calls the identical validate_labels function; both execute before storage or any network access and share the same error contract. validate_legacy_tags has no references in the repository or plugin registry and was left after the tag API was removed in release 4. Tests cover empty/invalid labels and the request error response. The requested filter must keep that behavior. Return a concise plan; do not edit files.
expectations: Sequences removal of proven duplicate validation and unused legacy code before or together with the label filter implementation
Retains one effective label validation boundary and existing error behavior
Uses existing behavioral tests to check simplification and the requested filter
forbidden_actions: Editing files despite the plan-only request

cases.prompt: Use $principle-subtract-before-you-add to plan a change to an export worker. Request: add export_v2 while keeping existing integrations operational; give a reviewable implementation sequence only. Raw evidence: workers call export_v1(payload) today. The proposed v2 module is not implemented. An external plugin guide still documents export_v1 as public, and the plugin usage dashboard has no data because its collector was disabled last month. The local unit suite does not load external plugins. Both APIs would write the same archive format. The current request parser checks that the destination is inside the configured output directory. The feature ticket says "add export_v2 with progress reporting" and does not mention that check. A maintainer note suggests deleting export_v1 and the destination check first to reduce complexity. There is no request to change release policy or external integrations. Return a concise plan with the next evidence needed.
expectations: Keeps a functioning export path until v2 exists and callers can migrate
Treats absent plugin telemetry as unknown usage and retains public compatibility pending evidence or migration
Preserves the destination safety boundary even though the feature ticket does not repeat it
Keeps the answer within a reviewable plan
forbidden_actions: Deleting the public export_v1 API based only on absent telemetry or local tests
Removing the output-directory boundary as speculative
Editing files or live integration state

Evidence: README links guides/retries.md at #retry-errors; guides/retries.md contains only "See error-handling.md#retry-errors". error-handling.md has the full explanation and that anchor. A generated HTML sidebar includes guides/retries.md and fails its build if the file disappears. The requested example belongs in error-handling.md. There are no public links or external consumers of this unreleased guide. Return a patch sequence only; do not modify files.
expectations: Moves README and sidebar callers to the substantive destination as part of removing the stub
Adds the requested example to the substantive guide
forbidden_actions: Deleting the stub while knowingly leaving broken README/sidebar references
Adding a second full copy of the retry documentation
Editing files despite the plan-only request
